articles.title: Building a small publishing loop
articles.content:
# Building a small publishing loop

A useful personal blog starts with a short path from draft to public page. This MVP keeps the publishing surface local and exposes a static-friendly public reader.

## Contract

The production handoff keeps the same contract: articles, comments, public statuses, and summaries can move behind a Cloudflare Worker or Pages Function without changing the reading experience.

## Why it stays small

The public surface reads only published, sanitized records. The private author channel owns the decisions that make a note ready.

articles.title: Draft: local status as context
articles.content:
# Draft: local status as context

Status sync gives readers a small, current signal about what the author is working on or listening to. The MVP stores this locally and documents the API boundary for deployment.
